successors.name: Tibetan Empire
successors.text: the Kashgar oasis: the Kashgar river oasis on the Northern Silk Road

ledger.x: c. 200 BCE: the oasis kingdom of Shule, 'an ancient oasis kingdom of the Taklamakan Desert on the Northern Silk Road', centred on Kashgar.
127: 'Shule began to pay tribute to the Eastern Han.'
220: Eastern Han ends; no page date for the end of tribute (bridged).
632: vassalized by the Tang; one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi 649-670; Tibetan conquest 670, Tang vassalage 673, Tang reconquest 692.
670: conquered by the Tibetan Empire (Tang vassalage resumed 673, reconquest 692).
790: the Shule kingdom ends under Tibetan conquest.

certainty.note: No boundary on the page; overlords changed repeatedly.
